-from starlette.responses import Response
+from starlette.background import BackgroundTask
+from starlette.responses import FileResponse, Response, StreamingResponse
 from starlette.testclient import WebSocketDenialResponse
 from starlette.types import Message, Receive, Scope, Send
 from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketState
@@ -322,6 +324,67 @@ def test_send_denial_response(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
     assert exc.value.content == b"foo"
 
 
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_send_denial_streaming_response() -> None:
+    background_calls = 0
+    messages: list[Message] = []
+
+    async def background() -> None:
+        nonlocal background_calls
+        background_calls += 1
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.connect"}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        messages.append(message)
+
+    scope: Scope = {"type": "websocket", "headers": [], "extensions": {"websocket.http.response": {}}}
+    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+    await websocket.receive()
+    response = StreamingResponse(
+        iter(["streamed", " body"]),
+        status_code=401,
+        background=BackgroundTask(background),
+    )
+    await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    assert messages[0]["type"] == "websocket.http.response.start"
+    assert messages[0]["status"] == 401
+    assert [message["type"] for message in messages[1:]] == ["websocket.http.response.body"] * 3
+    assert b"".join(message["body"] for message in messages[1:]) == b"streamed body"
+    assert messages[-1]["more_body"] is False
+    assert background_calls == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_send_denial_file_response(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "denial.txt"
+    path.write_bytes(b"file body")
+    messages: list[Message] = []
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.connect"}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        messages.append(message)
+
+    scope: Scope = {
+        "type": "websocket",
+        "headers": [],
+        "extensions": {"websocket.http.response": {}, "http.response.pathsend": {}},
+    }
+    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+    await websocket.receive()
+    await websocket.send_denial_response(FileResponse(path, status_code=403))
+
+    assert messages[0]["type"] == "websocket.http.response.start"
+    assert messages[0]["status"] == 403
+    assert [message["type"] for message in messages[1:]] == ["websocket.http.response.body"]
+    assert messages[1]["body"] == b"file body"
+    assert messages[1]["more_body"] is False
+
+
